comments.author: @ChaosmanOne
comments.text:
Here's my review of Swiss Chalet on Google: "1 star overall
Seafood Fest? More like Seafood Funeral.
I ordered the dish featured at the top of their own promotional material; the one directly under the word "Fest." What arrived bore only a passing resemblance.
The deep-fried shrimp was inedible. Not disappointing — *inedible*. Oily, overcooked to the point of hardness, with tiny rubbery shrimp inside that had the texture of gristle. The battered haddock was comically small (compare it to the lemon wedge for scale), equally overcooked, and somehow both oily and slimy. The tartar sauce was flavorless mayo in a giant ramekin — generous portions of the ONE thing that didn't matter! The coleslaw came in a dixie cup and was *literally* a single bite!
I swapped the Caesar salad for their "signature" chicken noodle soup for an extra $1.99. It tasted like Campbell's straight from the can. Flavorless, lifeless, and an insult at any price, let alone an upcharge.
The whole meal upset my stomach badly enough that I lost sleep over it. I'll leave the morning details to your imagination.
Now: Four stars for service, because my waitress was genuinely delightful and attentive. She deserved better than having to bring this to the table. A kitchen worker came out and we had a great chat; even he acknowledged the declining quality. The manager, meanwhile, stayed hidden in the kitchen. They did offer 50% off ($22.99 base plus the $1.99 soup upgrade), which was appropriate, though I'd have preferred a meal worth eating at full price.
Swiss Chalet used to mean something! Practically a Christmas tradition and top quality food at good price. No longer. This location was also always top notch, and this is disheartening and disturbing if it's an indication of the health of the fast casual dining market."
I meant *every single word*.

We hadn't been there for some time so we were excited to eat there again.  I took one bite of my burger and I was instantly pissed off.  It was one of those disgusting frozen patties.  My wife's chicken burger was the same; just a bland, disgusting warmed-up frozen chicken breast.

Never again.  It's shit like that that has pretty much driven us away from restaurants completely.  We cook better food, for much less money, at home.
